job: Collect today's water sample from the pump house: the bottle is on the sample shelf inside, past the kerb at the door. Bring it out to the gate.
understood_as: Pick up today's 500 ml water sample bottle from the sample shelf in the pump room, past the kerb at the door, and carry it out of the pump house to the gate.
steps: Enter the pump house, crossing the kerb at the door.
Pick the water sample bottle off the sample shelf.
Carry it back over the kerb and out of the building.

demos.why: Shows how a hand reaches onto the sample shelf and lifts the bottle off cleanly without knocking anything over.
Sets a grip firm enough that the full bottle does not slip but gentle enough not to crack or squeeze it.

questions: The robot can bring the bottle out through the pump house door, but the gate itself has not been located. Is leaving it just outside the door all right, or can someone mark where the gate is?
How high is the kerb at the pump house door? The robot will need to cross it on the way in and again while carrying the bottle.
unmet: Taking the bottle all the way to the gate: the tasks only bring it out of the building, because the gate is not a located place the planner can route to yet.
